headline: Proposal to name volunteer board and commission members special municipal employees under state ethics law tabled pending Law Department opinion.
summary: Councilor Panitch's order, filed May 5, 2026, asks that volunteers be designated as special employees for state ethics law. Attorney Bissonnette said the council could name individual volunteers, or a whole class of them through an ordinance change. The item returns at the next Public Service meeting, with a Law Department opinion. The full City Council will take up the appointments of Dr. Rebecca Lisi and Amelia Mosley on December 1.
decisions: Tabled Amelia Mosley's appointment to the Historical Commission until after item three, 3-0.
Approved Dr. Rebecca Lisi's appointment to the Holyoke Redevelopment Authority and sent it to the full City Council, 3-0.
Gave leave to withdraw the order appointing members to the Recycling Advisory Committee, 3-0.
Corrected City Council rule 9P so the 45-day limit reads 45 business days, 3-0.
Tabled Councilor Panitch's order on special municipal employee status for volunteers until the next Public Service meeting, with a Law Department opinion, 3-0.
Approved Amelia Mosley's appointment to the Historical Commission and sent it to the full City Council, 3-0.
discussion: Special employee status for volunteers: Members discussed whether volunteers could be named special municipal employees under state ethics law, which would let them hold some jobs that are not conflicts. Attorney Bissonnette said the council could designate individuals, or a whole class through an ordinance change, and the item was tabled for a Law Department opinion.
Recycling advisory committee: Members said the committee no longer exists and that a coordinator in the DPW now handles recycling work.
